transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I just... don't feel like myself anymore. I'm not really talking to anyone. I just go quiet. Even at work, getting started on my cleaning route... it feels like I'm pushing a loaded cart uphill. I just feel flat.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I... well, I don't have some big plan or anything. But... a lot of mornings, I wake up and just think... maybe it would be easier if I didn't wake up at all. It's... it scares me enough to actually say it out loud.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... a while now. I guess, the heavy feeling... the depression part of it... maybe a year and two months? It started up... not too long after I moved.
During the last two years, have you felt depressed most of the time?

Yeah... I guess so. Mostly since I moved, anyway. It's just... always there in the background. The sadness, the low energy... the guilt. Just not having much interest in things. Even on the days when... well... when other stuff is bothering me more. Like... the voices. Or... worrying about the cameras. Even when all that is the main thing on my mind... the down feeling is still just... sitting right there underneath it.
During this past year, has there been any time when the depression completely lifted for as long as two months?
No... no, I don't think so. It hasn't ever really gone away for that long. Just... maybe a day or two where it's not as bad, but... no, not two months.
Before this past year and two months, was there ever another time in your life when you felt this depressed for at least two weeks?
No... I don't think so. Not that I remember, anyway. Just... mainly since I moved.
Before you moved, were you already feeling depressed most days?
No... not really. It started... maybe just after I moved. So... it's been about a year and two months now, I guess. That it's been like this.
Was moving the main stressful event that happened right before these symptoms began?
Yeah... I guess so. It's been building up for... about a year and five months, I think. Just... ever since I had to leave my old apartment. And my old neighborhood. That's when it started.
During this past year and two months, was there ever a stretch of at least two weeks when your depression got noticeably worse than your usual baseline?
I don't know... not really. It's all just kind of been the same, I guess. I haven't really kept track of specific weeks like that. It just... stays.
Have the voices ever happened during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah... I suppose. There was a stretch... maybe a few weeks, where things weren't quite as heavy. I was getting through meals a little better... getting through my shifts at work easier. 

But... the other stuff didn't stop. I still heard my name in the stairwell. And... I still knew the cameras in the hallway were being used to track me. So... yeah. It still happens even then.
During this past month, have you been able to enjoy anything you usually like?

Not really. I used to... well, I used to go fishing on Saturdays. Or just sit with a coffee and do a crossword. Sometimes I'd even show the younger guys at work how to strip a floor right. But... I don't know. I mostly just let all that sit now. It doesn't... it doesn't give me anything back anymore. So I just don't bother.
Have these symptoms made it hard for you to keep up with your work or daily responsibilities?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. My supervisor... he started writing me up. Missed routes, mistakes I kept making when I was cleaning. I just... couldn't keep the routine straight anymore. I finally had to go to the employee assistance program because of it. And... outside of work, I just stopped. Stopped going to church, stopped fishing... stopped checking in on people I used to talk to. Just... couldn't keep up.
Do you feel that losing your old apartment was what caused this depression to start?

I... I don't know if it caused it. I try not to think about it too much. But... yeah, I guess the depression part has been with me for about a year and two months now. It started not long after the move. So... maybe.
Have you been sleeping much more or much less than usual?
I guess I sleep about the same. Haven't really paid attention.
Have you had much less appetite than usual lately?

I suppose. I don't really... care much for eating lately. Most days it just tastes like cardboard anyway. So I just skip meals... or maybe just have a few crackers after my shift. I guess my work pants have been hanging a bit looser than they used to. But... yeah.
Have you been feeling depressed like this for at least two full years?
No... I thought I just said it's been about a year and two months. Not two years. Just... since the move.
Do you feel your depression is mainly a reaction to having to move from your old apartment?
I don't really know. I couldn't tell you if it caused it or not. Just... that's when things started feeling this way. I don't really think about the why of it.
Do you feel hopeless?
I guess so. Sometimes. I don't really see things getting much better. It just... is what it is, I suppose.
Do you find yourself thinking a lot about having to leave your old apartment?
Not really. I mean... I don't dwell on it. It's just a place. I don't think about it much at all.
Have you been feeling anxious or tense a lot lately?
Not really. I just... feel tired, mostly. Not tense. Just tired.
